title: Watchmens Pistols - Memo Of Musketry Officer SMPI

page_data.en:
D. 3547.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3547
Date 21/8/31
S. M. P. Armoury.
August 18, 1931.
A 1314/32
Watchmen's Pistols
D. C. (Crime).
Sir,
There seems to be a slight misunderstanding of
my responsibility as M/O which so far as weapons
are concerned is as follows :-
1. Care and distribution of all Police Weapons,
which includes 500 set aside for Watchmen all
of which are Police property.
2. I am not in any way responsible for Watchmen
Weapons even if they are licensed, on account
of them being private property.
3. It is only a concession and is entirely a private
matter between the Armourer and the owner if he
repairs a licensed weapon for anyone.
4. The repair of an unlicensed weapon by the Armourer
is prohibited.
5. The Armourer acting under my advice, will not now
repair any weapon unless he can guarantee it.
6. The fact that my name appears on a Memo notifying
the Stations that a weapon will not justify it
being repaired, is only owing to the Armourer not
being able to write English.
Quite a number of weapons that have in the past
been licensed for use of Watchmen should not have
been. They are in a number of cases "Not Safe"
and even dangerous.
I have not confiscated any private or other weapons
and have not the power to do so. I only receive
surrendered weapons that are ordered confiscated
（批：That this refers to licences & has been on Police Charge yes, but he has been repairing unlicensed weapons on police charge. It is true perhaps, but what if it is on police charge? I mean that all such weapons must be seized or licences cancelled unless the Station wants to deal with them. I think the armoury should be told to refuse to repair any weapon unless it is licensed & safe.）
page_data.zh:
D. 3547.
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3547
日期 1931年8月21日
上海公共租界工部局警务处军械库。
1931年8月18日。
A 1314/32
巡捕手枪
D. C.（犯罪科）。

先生，

关于我作为军械官（M/O）的职责，似乎存在一点误解，就武器而言，我的职责如下：-

1. 负责所有警用武器的保管和分发，其中包括为巡捕预留的500支，这些均属于警方财产。
2. 我对巡捕的武器不承担任何责任，即使它们持有执照，因为它们是私人财产。
3. 如果军械师为任何人修理持照武器，这仅仅是一种通融，完全是军械师与所有者之间的私人事务。
4. 禁止军械师修理无照武器。
5. 军械师在我的建议下，除非能保证武器的安全性，否则现在不会修理任何武器。
6. 我的名字出现在通知各分局某武器不予修理的备忘录上，这仅仅是因为军械师不懂英文。

过去有许多获准供巡捕使用的武器本不应获得许可。在许多情况下，这些武器“不安全”，甚至具有危险性。

我没有没收任何私人或其他武器，也没有权力这样做。我只接收法院命令没收或个人上交的武器
（批注：此处指的是执照问题，且确实由警方负责保管，是的，但他一直在警方保管下修理无照武器。也许这是事实，但如果是在警方保管下又怎样？我的意思是，除非分局希望处理这些武器，否则所有此类武器必须被扣押或吊销执照。我认为应告知军械库，除非武器持有执照且安全，否则拒绝修理。）

page_data.en:
( 2 )

by the Courts or surrendered by individuals. They
are then recommended to the Commissioner for his
approval for destruction in the usual manner. When
a weapon supplied by the Police for Watchmen is
found defective and beyond repair it is withdrawn
from issue and kept in the Armoury until permission
is obtained from the C. of P. to destroy it.

9. We have over 6000 police weapons in the Force
awaiting overhaul, a great number of which are in
a disgraceful state owing to the neglect of those
who were responsible for their efficiency and I can
not at the present time undertake any further
responsibility such as going into consultation with
owners of private weapons to try and convince them
that they should surrender their defective weapons
for destruction. In say, 18/20 months time the
Armoury may be able to handle this matter, but at
the present time, it is impossible as stated above.

10. I would submit that where Stations or the Licensing
Section have weapons that the owner cannot get
repaired (Lee's) that the owner be notified that after
an interval of one month that the weapons will be
taken to Court and permission asked to have them
destroyed or confiscated, as it is obvious that the
license only covers a Safe and Effective Weapon.
The origin of the weapons in question is :-

A. Private weapons purchased privately by the owners.
B. They may have been purchased through members of the
Force as a matter of courtesy.
None of these weapons have been purchased from the
Police Dept..
The only weapon the Police Depts have ever sold are

（批：not now count rifle them Recd）
（批：True but private unlicenced weapons have been on charge at Stations. Recd）
（批：Licence conditions do not provide that weapon must be safe + if a person want to licence an old relic objection can any officer see any concern it is no offence of Court.）
（批：But why not offer to buy back? Possibly some good rifles among them. Suggest this.）
page_data.zh:
( 2 )

然后建议提交给警务处长批准，按常规方式予以销毁。当发现供巡捕使用的警用武器有缺陷且无法修复时，将其从配发中撤回，并保存在军械库中，直到获得警务处长（C. of P.）的销毁许可。

9. 本局有超过6000支警用武器等待大修，其中许多因负责其效能的人员疏忽而处于令人羞耻的状态，我目前无法承担进一步的责任，例如与私人武器所有者协商，试图说服他们上交有缺陷的武器予以销毁。可以说，在18到20个月后，军械库或许能够处理此事，但就目前而言，如上所述，这是不可能的。

10. 我建议，如果各分局或执照科存有所有者无法修复的武器（李氏枪行），应通知所有者，在一个月后，这些武器将被提交至法院，请求许可予以销毁或没收，因为显然执照仅涵盖安全且有效的武器。
有关武器的来源如下：-

A. 所有者私下购买的私人武器。
B. 可能是出于礼节，通过本局成员购买的。
这些武器均非从警务处购买。
警务处出售过的唯一武器是

（批注：现在不算步枪了，已收到）
（批注：属实，但私人无照武器一直由各分局保管。已收到）
（批注：执照条件并未规定武器必须安全+如果一个人想为旧古董申请执照，任何警官能看到什么关切吗？这并非法院的违法行为。）
（批注：但为何不提供回购？其中可能有一些好的步枪。建议此举。）

page_data.en:
( 3 )

Colt Auto: Pistol which can be repaired, as we carry
Spares.
The majority of these weapons are "Junk" and would
never have been approved for service for Watchmen
by the present Licensing Section.
They were never in the Police Store or even registered
there and the Police are in no way called upon to
assist in having them repaired. They have never passed
through Police hands and if they have a "Court Record"
it is not officially known, I would go so far as to
say that the majority were imported without a Customs
Permit.

（左侧手写批注：）
The section never has
anything to do with it
in any case the old
"junk" was approved by
a Board of which
Supt. F. was a member
I think those
supplied by owners
were accepted by station
as effective.
True but we are
gradually getting these
records.

W Stanburn
Musketry Officer.

（下方手写批注：）
The remarks above are
irrelevant as I now
understand that this
also, refers to weapons
privately supplied & not
to confiscated weapons
used for watchmen.
Ray.
page_data.zh:
( 3 )

柯尔特自动手枪，我们可以修理，因为我们有备件。
这些武器大多数是“废品”，按照目前的执照科标准，绝不会批准用于巡捕服役。
它们从未进入过警用仓库，甚至未在那里登记，警方没有任何义务协助修理它们。它们从未经过警方之手，如果它们有“法院记录”，官方并不知晓，我甚至可以说，大多数是在没有海关许可证的情况下进口的。

（左侧手写批注：）
该股无论如何都与此无关，
总之，旧的
“废品”是由一个委员会批准的，
F. 巡官是该委员会的成员
我认为那些
由所有者提供的
被分局接受为有效武器。
属实，但我们正
逐渐获取这些记录。

W Stanburn
射击教官。

（下方手写批注：）
上述评论无关紧要，因为我
现在了解到，这也
指的是私人提供的武器，而非
用于巡捕的被没收武器。
Ray.
